title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: I'm bad at this
hook: A player says, I'm just bad at this.
intro: They strike out three times in a row.
Then they say it out loud.
statement: Kids believe what they say about themselves.
q1: Do you add the word yet and move on —
q2: or stop and point out what they do well?
q3: What was true the first week of practice?
t1: Every kid is different. But players keep trying
t2: when they see that skills can grow.
cta: Coaches — what do you say back?
ctaLines: Not yet. Look how far you've come. Try it again.
A quick word or a real talk?
ctaPrompt: Share your response below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A player says, I'm just bad at this.
They strike out three times in a row. Then they say it out loud.
Kids believe what they say about themselves.
A quick not yet or a real talk. Both can work.
What do you say back? Share your habit in the comments.
